vocabulary.definition: a line that marks the limits of an area; a dividing line
vocabulary.example: The fence serves as the boundary between our properties.

vocabulary.definition: having an excessive preoccupation with something; constantly thinking about it
vocabulary.example: She became obsessive about cleaning, spending hours each day tidying up.

vocabulary.definition: protected or defended from danger, harm, or unpleasant experiences
vocabulary.example: The thick walls shielded the house from the strong winds outside.

vocabulary.definition: the inside part or space within something
vocabulary.example: The car's interior was spacious and well-designed.

vocabulary.definition: difficult or impossible to understand, explain, or identify
vocabulary.example: The disappearance of the ancient civilization remains a mysterious event.

vocabulary.definition: relating to the universe or cosmos, especially as distinct from the earth
vocabulary.example: The scientist studied cosmic radiation coming from distant galaxies.
